signature: CommitFailedException: Commit failed: Table was updated concurrently
likely_causes: Simultaneous write jobs committing to the same partition
diagnostic_steps: Inspect Iceberg table snapshots and commit timestamps
Check write isolation mode (Serializable vs Snapshot)
fixes: Configure commit.retry.num-retries and commit.retry.min-wait-ms in table properties
Ensure writes to disjoint partitions or separate staging tables
unsafe_fixes: Disabling concurrency checks in Spark session
verification: Re-run batch write with retry backoff enabled
rollback: Clean uncommitted metadata files from table location
